text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer <username>! Thank you for your hard 
work.
choice_data_list: It's rare to see you in a place like this.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I was having a meeting with the 
Academy staff today regarding the next 
live event.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
And so... out of old habit, I found myself 
wandering over to this training ground.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Such a nostalgic place... I tasted so much 
bitter frustration here. Yet by the same 
token, it's full of unforgettable 
memories...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san. Please make sure the girl in 
your charge gets plenty of training and 
performs in lots and lots of Winning 
Lives, okay?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ah, please leave the concert direction to 
me! I'll come up with a stage where you'll 
shine your brightest!
